title: Pod Dispatcher app schema
description: Declarative description of one podcast app/platform: how to parse its incoming URLs (source) and/or how to deep link into it (target). A schema must define at least one of the two blocks. No executable code is permitted — only patterns and templates interpreted by the native engine.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Must match the filename (e.g. id 'apple-podcasts' lives in apple-podcasts.yml).

name.description: Human-readable app/platform name shown in the UI.

templateString.description: String with {variable} placeholders, optionally filtered: {var|urlencode}, {var|strip-scheme} or {var|base64url}.

source.description: How to recognise this platform's share URLs and resolve them to a canonical podcast identity (RSS feed URL plus optional episode info).

hosts.description: Hostnames this source matches (lowercase, no scheme). The Android app generates its manifest intent filters from this list at build time; a brand-new host therefore still needs the next app release to be intercepted (Android limitation), but no manual manifest edit.

patterns.description: URL patterns tried in order; the first match wins. Put more specific patterns (e.g. episode) before broader ones (e.g. show).

androidSource.description: Android-specific interception hints, consumed when the app generates its manifest intent filters at build time. Without it, every path on the source's hosts is intercepted.

paths.description: Narrows interception to these URL paths so unrelated links on shared hosts (e.g. Spotify music) stay untouched. Entries combine as OR. Keep them in sync with what 'patterns' can actually parse.

pattern.description: Android glob pattern (android:pathPattern syntax: '.' any char, '.*' wildcard, '\\' escape — NOT a full regex).

level.description: What kind of link this pattern identifies.

path.description: Regex matched against the URL path (Java/Kotlin syntax). Use named capture groups: (?<showId>\d+). Captured values become template variables for the resolver.

query.description: Map of required query parameter name → regex matched against its value. All listed parameters must be present and match. Named capture groups are merged into the captures.

resolve.description: How to turn captured values into a canonical podcast identity. Resolver types are implemented natively; schemas only configure them.

id.description: iTunes collection id, e.g. '{showId}'. The engine calls the iTunes Lookup API and reads results[0].feedUrl.

episodeId.description: Optional iTunes episode trackId (Apple's ?i= URL parameter), e.g. '{episodeId}'. When set, episode-level links are resolved via entity=podcastEpisode, yielding {episodeGuid}, {episodeTitle} and {episodeUrl}. Episodes outside the lookup window degrade to show level.

url.description: Optional template for the page to fetch (e.g. a directory page keyed by a captured id). Defaults to the incoming URL itself.

feedUrl.description: Extraction steps tried in order against the fetched page; the first non-empty result wins.

itunesId.description: Optional extraction steps for the show's iTunes id, enabling Apple-id-keyed target links.

params.description: Reserved. Podcast Index resolution requires API credentials and is not yet enabled in the engine.

css.description: CSS selector; the first matching element is used.

attr.description: Attribute to read from the element, or 'text' for its text content. URL-valued attributes are resolved to absolute URLs.

jsonld.description: Dotted path evaluated against each <script type="application/ld+json"> block, e.g. 'associatedMedia.contentUrl' or 'itemListElement.0.url'. Numeric segments index into arrays.

scrapePattern.description: Optional regex applied to the extracted value; the first capture group becomes the result. The step fails if the regex doesn't match.

target.description: How to deep link into this app given a canonical podcast identity. Available template variables: {feedUrl} (always), {itunesId}, {episodeGuid}, {episodeTitle}, {episodeUrl} (when resolved). A template whose variables are unavailable is skipped.

package.description: Android application id. The deep link intent is pinned to this package. The app generates its manifest <queries> entry (Android 11+ package visibility) from this field at build time.

links.description: Deep link templates per level, tried in order until one launches.

episodeFallback.description: What to do when an episode link cannot be built: 'show' opens the show instead (graceful fallback), 'none' fails.
